title: How I approach performance
body: Performance work starts with field and lab measurement, not guesses: Lighthouse in CI and Datadog RUM in production, then the specific Core Web Vital that is failing, before touching any code. That measure-first discipline is what drove the LCP and bundle-size work on Sonny's Quivio and the server-rendering and caching work on the UPSC portal — see Impact for the measured results.

flow.title: Measure
flow.body: Lighthouse in the build pipeline, Datadog RUM for real-user field data.

flow.title: Locate
flow.body: Attribute the regression to a specific vital and a specific route or component.

flow.title: Reduce
flow.body: Code splitting, lazy loading, dependency and asset trimming to shrink the critical path.

flow.title: Render earlier
flow.body: SSR/ISR, pagination and caching so the first meaningful paint does not wait on the client.

flow.title: Guard
flow.body: Re-measure, then keep budgets and monitoring in place so the win holds.

flowCaption: Conceptual workflow — illustrative, not a production architecture diagram.
